sentences.zh: 志八十八

translations.literal: Treatise eighty-eight
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 88

sentences.zh: 選舉八

translations.literal: Selection and examinations eight
translations.idiomatic: Selection and Examinations 8

sentences.zh: 新選舉

translations.literal: New elections
translations.idiomatic: New Elections

sentences.zh: 新選舉制，別於歷代取士官人之法。

translations.literal: The new election system differed from the methods by which past dynasties recruited scholar-officials.
translations.idiomatic: The new election system was distinct from the ways earlier dynasties had selected and appointed scholar-officials.

sentences.zh: 清季豫備憲政，仿各國代議制度，選舉議員，博採輿論。

translations.literal: In the late Qing, in preparing for constitutional government, they imitated the representative systems of various countries, elected members of parliament, and broadly gathered public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: As the late Qing prepared for constitutional rule, it modeled foreign parliamentary systems, elected legislators, and sought broadly to take in public opinion.

sentences.zh: 議員選舉有二：曰資政院議員選舉，曰各省諮議局議員選舉。

translations.literal: Election of members was of two kinds: election of members of the Imperial Consultative Assembly, and election of members of the provincial consultative assemblies.
translations.idiomatic: Member elections fell into two categories: elections for the Imperial Consultative Assembly and elections for each province's consultative assembly.

sentences.zh: 自辛丑迴鑾，朝廷銳意求治，派大臣赴各國考察政治，設考察政治館。

translations.literal: From the return of the court to the capital in the xinchou year, the court was keen to seek good governance, dispatched grand ministers to various countries to investigate politics, and established the Bureau for the Investigation of Politics.
translations.idiomatic: After the court returned to the capital in 1901, it pressed hard for reform, sent senior ministers abroad to study political systems, and set up a bureau to investigate foreign governance.

sentences.zh: 命甄擇各國政法，斟酌損益，候旨裁定。

translations.literal: It ordered that the political laws of various countries be selected and weighed for increase or decrease, to await the imperial decision for final determination.
translations.idiomatic: It ordered a careful selection of foreign constitutional models to be adapted as needed, pending the throne's final approval.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年七月，詔曰：「考察政治大臣載澤等回國陳奏，國勢不振，由於上下相暌，內外隔閡；

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the thirty-second year of Guangxu, an edict said: 'The ministers investigating politics, Zaize and others, returned to the country and memorialized that the national strength was not flourishing because of estrangement between above and below and barriers between inside and outside;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 1906, an edict declared: "The ministers sent to study politics abroad, Zaize and his colleagues, reported on their return that the nation's vigor had waned because rulers and ruled had grown apart and court and country had fallen out of step;

sentences.zh: 而各國所以富強，在實行憲法，取決公論。

translations.literal: whereas the reason various countries became rich and strong lay in actually implementing a constitution and taking decisions from public discussion.
translations.idiomatic: yet other states had grown powerful by putting constitutions into practice and letting public deliberation decide policy.

sentences.zh: 今日惟有仿行憲政，大權統於朝廷，庶政公諸輿論，廓清積弊，明定責成，以豫備立憲基礎。

translations.literal: Today there is only to imitate and implement constitutional government, with great power unified in the court, ordinary administration referred to public opinion, sweeping away accumulated abuses, clearly fixing responsibility, in order to prepare the foundation for establishing a constitution.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth we must follow their example: supreme authority must remain with the throne, routine governance must be open to public debate, entrenched abuses must be cleared away, and responsibilities must be plainly assigned, so as to lay the groundwork for constitutional rule.

sentences.zh: 俟規模初具，妥議立憲實行期限。

translations.literal: When the framework is initially complete, properly deliberate the deadline for implementing the constitution.
translations.idiomatic: Once the institutions are in place, a suitable date for the constitution's full implementation shall be settled.

sentences.zh: 各省將軍、督、撫曉諭士庶人等，各明忠君愛國之義，合群進化之理，尊崇秩序，保守和平，豫備立憲國民之資格。

translations.literal: The generals, governors, and governors-general of each province were to instruct the gentry and common people to understand the meaning of loyalty to the ruler and love of country, the principle of collective advancement, to revere order, preserve peace, and prepare the qualifications of citizens under a constitutional government.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial military governors and civil governors were to instruct gentry and commoners alike in loyalty to the throne, love of country, the duty of civic association, respect for order, and the preservation of peace, so that they might qualify as citizens under a future constitution.

sentences.zh: 」九月，慶親王奕劻等遵旨核議釐定官制，以「立憲國官制，立法、行政、司法三權並峙，各有專屬，相輔而行。

translations.literal: ' In the ninth month, Prince Qing Yikuang and others, following the edict, deliberated and fixed the official system, stating that 'in the official system of a constitutional state, the three powers of legislation, administration, and judiciary stand side by side, each with its own sphere, assisting one another in operation.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month, Prince Qing Yikuang and his colleagues, acting on imperial orders, reviewed and settled the official system, observing that "in a constitutional state the legislative, executive, and judicial powers stand alongside one another, each with its proper domain, yet working in concert.

sentences.zh: 立法當屬議院，今日尚難實行。

translations.literal: Legislation ought to belong to the parliament; today it is still difficult to put into practice.
translations.idiomatic: Legislation properly belongs to a parliament, but that cannot yet be realized.

sentences.zh: 請暫設資政院，以為豫備」。

translations.literal: We request provisionally to establish the Imperial Consultative Assembly as preparation.'
translations.idiomatic: We therefore ask that an Imperial Consultative Assembly be established for the time being as a preparatory step."

sentences.zh: 詔如所議。

translations.literal: An edict approved as deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，改考察政治館為憲政編查館。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, the Bureau for the Investigation of Politics was changed to the Constitutional Compilation Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In 1907 the Bureau for the Investigation of Politics was renamed the Constitutional Compilation Bureau.

sentences.zh: 八月，諭曰：「立憲政體，取決公論，中國上、下議院未能成立，亟宜設資政院，以立議院基礎。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, an instruction said: 'A constitutional polity takes its decisions from public discussion; China's upper and lower houses of parliament cannot yet be established, and it is urgent to set up the Imperial Consultative Assembly to lay the foundation for a parliament.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month an imperial instruction declared: "Constitutional government rests on public deliberation; since China's upper and lower houses cannot yet be formed, an Imperial Consultative Assembly should be established at once as the foundation of a future parliament.

sentences.zh: 派溥倫、孫家鼐為資政院總裁，妥擬院章，請旨施行。

translations.literal: Pu Lun and Sun Jianai were appointed presidents of the Imperial Consultative Assembly, to draft the assembly regulations properly and request imperial approval for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Lun and Sun Jianai were appointed presidents of the assembly and charged to draft its regulations for imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 」尋諭：「各省應有採取輿論之所，俾指陳通省利病，籌計地方治安，並為資政院儲才之階。

translations.literal: ' Shortly afterward an instruction said: 'Each province ought to have a place for gathering public opinion, so that one may point out the benefits and harms of the whole province, plan for local public security, and also provide a ladder of talent for the Imperial Consultative Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon afterward came further instructions: "Each province needs a forum for public opinion, where men may set forth the province's needs and ills, deliberate on local order, and supply a training ground for future members of the Imperial Consultative Assembly.

sentences.zh: 各省督、撫於省會速設諮議局，慎選公正明達官紳，創辦其事。

translations.literal: The governors and governors-general of each province were to speedily establish consultative assemblies at the provincial capitals, carefully selecting upright and enlightened officials and gentry to undertake the founding.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial governors were to establish consultative assemblies quickly at their capitals, choosing upright and capable officials and gentry to launch the work.

sentences.zh: 由各屬合格紳民，公舉賢能為議員。

translations.literal: From qualified gentry and commoners of each subordinate district, worthy and able men were to be publicly elected as members.
translations.idiomatic: Qualified gentry and commoners in each district were to elect capable men as members by public ballot.

sentences.zh: 斷不可使品行悖謬、營私武斷之人濫廁其間。

translations.literal: Under no circumstances were persons of depraved conduct who pursued private gain and acted arbitrarily to be allowed to crowd in among them.
translations.idiomatic: Men of corrupt character who pursued private gain or ruled by arbitrary fiat must on no account be allowed to slip in among them.

sentences.zh: 凡地方應興應革事宜，議員公同集議，候本省大吏裁奪施行。

translations.literal: On all matters in the locality that ought to be promoted or reformed, the members were to deliberate together in assembly, awaiting decision and implementation by the great officials of the province.
translations.idiomatic: On all local matters requiring promotion or reform, members were to deliberate jointly, leaving final decision and execution to the provincial authorities.

sentences.zh: 將來資政院選舉議員，由該局公推遞升。

translations.literal: When in the future members of the Imperial Consultative Assembly were elected, they were to be publicly nominated and advanced upward from these assemblies.
translations.idiomatic: Future elections to the Imperial Consultative Assembly would draw members upward by public nomination from these provincial bodies.

sentences.zh: 三十四年六月，資政院奏言：「立憲國之有議院，所以代表民情，議員多由人民公舉。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the thirty-fourth year, the Imperial Consultative Assembly memorialized: 'Constitutional states have parliaments in order to represent the feelings of the people; members are mostly publicly elected by the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1908 the Imperial Consultative Assembly memorialized: "Constitutional states maintain parliaments to represent the people's will; members are for the most part chosen by public election.

sentences.zh: 凡立法及豫算、決算，必經議院協贊，方足啟國人信服之心。

translations.literal: All legislation as well as budgets and final accounts must pass through parliamentary assent before the hearts of the people of the state can be opened to trust.
translations.idiomatic: Legislation, budgets, and final accounts must all receive parliamentary assent if the nation is to place its trust in government.

sentences.zh: 大學云：『民之所好好之，民之所惡惡之。

translations.literal: The Great Learning says: 'What the people consider good, consider good; what the people consider bad, consider bad.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Learning says: "What the people approve, approve; what the people condemn, condemn.

sentences.zh: 』孟子云：『所欲與聚，所惡勿施。

translations.literal: ' Mencius said: 'Gather for them what they desire; do not impose on them what they detest.
translations.idiomatic: " Mencius said: "Give the people what they desire; do not visit on them what they hate.

sentences.zh: 』又云：『樂以天下，憂以天下。

translations.literal: ' He also said: 'Take the world's joy as joy, take the world's sorrow as sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: " He also said: "Rejoice with all under Heaven; grieve with all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 』皆此理也。

translations.literal: ' All embody this principle.
translations.idiomatic: " All express the same principle.

sentences.zh: 昔先哲王致萬民於外朝，而詢國危國遷，實開各國議院之先聲。

translations.literal: In antiquity the sage kings brought the myriad people to the outer court and inquired about national peril and national removal; this truly opened the precursor sound of the parliaments of various countries.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity sage kings summoned the people to the outer court and asked whether the state stood in peril or should be moved—truly the forerunner of every nation's parliament.

sentences.zh: 日本豫備立憲，於明治四年設左、右院，七年開地方會議，八年立元老院，二十三年遂頒憲法而開國會。

translations.literal: Japan, in preparing for constitutional government, in the fourth year of Meiji established the Left and Right Councils, in the seventh year opened local assemblies, in the eighth year established the House of Elders, and in the twenty-third year then promulgated a constitution and opened a national parliament.
translations.idiomatic: Japan's path to constitutional rule began with Left and Right Councils in Meiji 4, local assemblies in Meiji 7, a House of Elders in Meiji 8, and finally a constitution and national Diet in Meiji 23.

sentences.zh: 所以籌立議院之基者至詳且備。

translations.literal: Thus the laying of the foundation for establishing a parliament was carried to the utmost detail and completeness.
translations.idiomatic: Its preparations for a parliament were thus thorough in the extreme.

sentences.zh: 謹旁考各國成規，揆以中國情勢，酌擬院章目次，凡十章。

translations.literal: Respectfully examining the established regulations of various countries side by side and measuring them against China's circumstances, we have drafted the table of contents for the assembly regulations, ten chapters in all.
translations.idiomatic: Having surveyed foreign precedents and weighed them against China's circumstances, we have drafted a ten-chapter outline for the assembly's regulations.

sentences.zh: 先擬就總綱、選舉二章呈覽。

translations.literal: We have first drafted the two chapters on general provisions and elections for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: We submit first the chapters on general provisions and elections for Your Majesty's review.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: ' The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne approved the memorial.

sentences.zh: 是月憲政編查館會同資政院擬訂各省諮議局章程，並議員選舉章程。

translations.literal: That month the Constitutional Compilation Bureau, together with the Imperial Consultative Assembly, drafted the regulations for the provincial consultative assemblies of each province, as well as regulations for the election of members.
translations.idiomatic: That same month the Constitutional Compilation Bureau and the Imperial Consultative Assembly jointly drafted regulations for provincial consultative assemblies and for the election of their members.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「立憲政體之要義，在予人民以與聞政事之權，而使為行政官吏之監察。

translations.literal: They memorialized: 'The essential meaning of a constitutional polity lies in granting the people the right to participate in hearing political affairs, and making them the overseers of administrative officials.
translations.idiomatic: They memorialized: "The essence of constitutional government is to give the people a voice in public affairs and to make them overseers of the officials who administer them.

sentences.zh: 東、西立憲各國，雖國體不同，法制各異，無不設立議院，使人民選舉議員，代表輿論。

translations.literal: Eastern and Western constitutional countries, though their forms of state differ and their legal systems vary, all without exception establish parliaments, enabling the people to elect members who represent public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: Every constitutional state, East or West, whatever its form of government or legal system, establishes a parliament and lets the people elect members to speak for public opinion.

sentences.zh: 是以上下之情通，暌隔之弊少。

translations.literal: Thus sentiments above and below are connected and the harm of estrangement is reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Thus sentiment flows between rulers and ruled, and the evils of estrangement are diminished.

sentences.zh: 中國向無議院之說，今議倡設，人多視為創舉。

translations.literal: China has had no tradition of parliaments; now that the proposal to establish them is raised, many regard it as an unprecedented innovation.
translations.idiomatic: China has never known parliaments; many therefore regard the present proposal as something wholly new.

sentences.zh: 不知虞廷之明目達聰，大禹之建鞀設鐸，洪範之謀及庶人，周官之詢於外朝，古昔盛時，無不廣采與論，以為行政之準則，特未有議院之制度耳。

translations.literal: They do not know that in the court of Yu there was clear-sightedness and keen hearing, that Yu the Great established drums and set up bells, that the Great Plan took counsel down to commoners, and that the Offices of Zhou inquired in the outer court—in flourishing ages of antiquity, none failed broadly to gather opinion as the standard for administration; only the institution of a parliament did not yet exist.
translations.idiomatic: They forget that the court of Yu sought clear sight and keen hearing, that Yu the Great set up drums and bells for public remonstrance, that the Great Plan enjoined consulting the common people, and that the Rites of Zhou required inquiry in the outer court—in every golden age antiquity gathered opinion broadly as the standard of rule; only the institution of a parliament was lacking.

sentences.zh: 今將創設議院，若不嚴定規則，事為之制，曲為之防，流弊不可勝言。

translations.literal: Now that parliaments are to be newly established, if strict rules are not fixed, matters regulated, and safeguards bent around them, the resulting abuses cannot be fully described.
translations.idiomatic: If parliaments are now to be created without strict rules, regulated procedures, and careful safeguards, abuses will follow beyond numbering.

sentences.zh: 中國地大民眾，分省而治。

translations.literal: China is vast in territory and numerous in population, governed by division into provinces.
translations.idiomatic: China is vast and populous, ruled through provincial division.

sentences.zh: 各省之政，主於督、撫，與各國地方之治直接國都者不同。

translations.literal: The government of each province is headed by governors and governors-general, differing from the local governance of various countries that connects directly to the national capital.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial administration rests with governors and governors-general, unlike local government abroad, which often reports directly to the national capital.

sentences.zh: 而郡縣之制，異於封建，督、撫事事受命於朝廷，亦與各國聯邦之各為法制者不同。

translations.literal: Moreover, the commandery-and-county system differs from feudal enfeoffment; governors and governors-general receive orders on every matter from the court, which also differs from federations in various countries where each unit has its own legal system.
translations.idiomatic: The commandery-and-county system differs from feudal partition, and governors take their orders on every matter from the court—unlike federations abroad, where each member state makes its own laws.

sentences.zh: 諮議局為地方自治與中央集權之樞紐，必使下足裒集一省之輿論，上仍無妨國家統一之大權。

translations.literal: The consultative assembly is the pivot between local self-government and central concentration of power; below it must fully gather a province's public opinion, while above it must still not obstruct the great authority of national unity.
translations.idiomatic: The consultative assembly is the hinge between local autonomy and central authority: below, it must gather a province's opinion in full; above, it must not impair the nation's unity of power.

sentences.zh: 此日各省諮議局辦法，必須與異日京師議院辦法有相成而無相悖。

translations.literal: The methods for the provincial consultative assemblies of this day must be mutually complementary and not contradictory with the methods for the capital parliament of a future day.
translations.idiomatic: Today's provincial consultative assemblies must complement, not conflict with, the capital parliament of the future.

sentences.zh: 謹仰體聖訓，博考各國立法之意，兼采外省所擬章程，參伍折衷，擬訂各省諮議局章程，別為選舉章程一百十五條，候欽定頒行。

translations.literal: Respectfully embodying the sacred instruction, broadly examining the legislative intent of various countries, also adopting regulations drafted by outer provinces, comparing and reconciling them, we have drafted regulations for the provincial consultative assemblies of each province, with a separate set of one hundred fifteen articles of election regulations, awaiting imperial confirmation for promulgation.
translations.idiomatic: In obedience to imperial instruction, having studied foreign legislative intent and incorporated drafts from the provinces, we have reconciled them into regulations for provincial consultative assemblies, with a separate code of one hundred fifteen articles on elections, pending Your Majesty's approval for promulgation.

sentences.zh: 」詔飭各督、撫迅速舉辦，實力奉行，限一年內一律辦齊。

translations.literal: ' An edict ordered each governor and governor-general to undertake the matter speedily, earnestly carry it out, with a limit of one year for all to be completed uniformly.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict commanded all governors to proceed at once, enforce the regulations in earnest, and complete the work within one year.

sentences.zh: 並諭曰：「朝廷軫念民依，使國民與聞政事。

translations.literal: An instruction also said: 'The court is solicitous for the people's dependence, enabling nationals to participate in hearing political affairs.
translations.idiomatic: A further instruction declared: "The court cares deeply for its people and opens public affairs to national participation.

sentences.zh: 先於各省設諮議局，以資歷練。

translations.literal: First in each province consultative assemblies are established to provide experience and training.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial consultative assemblies are established first to provide training and experience.

sentences.zh: 凡我士庶，當共體時艱，同攄忠愛。

translations.literal: All our gentry and commoners ought together to embody the hardships of the times and jointly express loyalty and love.
translations.idiomatic: Let all gentry and commoners share the burdens of the age and give voice together to loyalty and devotion.

sentences.zh: 於地方應興應革之利弊，切實指陳。

translations.literal: On the benefits and harms of what ought to be promoted or reformed in the locality, point them out earnestly and concretely.
translations.idiomatic: Speak plainly and concretely on what local affairs should be advanced or reformed, and on their benefits and costs.

sentences.zh: 於國民應盡之義務，應循之秩序，竭誠踐守。

translations.literal: On the duties nationals ought to fulfill and the order they ought to follow, practice and preserve them with full sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Fulfill faithfully the duties of citizenship and observe the order that binds the nation.

sentences.zh: 各督、撫當本集思廣益之懷，行好惡同民之政，虛衷審察，惟善是從。

translations.literal: Each governor and governor-general ought, based on the mind of gathering many thoughts for broad benefit, to carry out government that shares the people's likes and dislikes, examine with open heart, and follow only what is good.
translations.idiomatic: Governors should take counsel widely, govern in sympathy with the people's likes and dislikes, examine proposals with open minds, and follow only what is good.

sentences.zh: 至選舉議員，尤宜督率有司，認真監督，精擇慎選。

translations.literal: As for electing members, it is especially fitting to supervise and lead the responsible officials, earnestly oversee, and select with care and caution.
translations.idiomatic: Above all, in electing members, governors must supervise their subordinates closely, oversee the process earnestly, and choose with the utmost care.

sentences.zh: 憲政編查館、資政院迅將君主立憲大綱，暨議院選舉各法，擇要編輯。

translations.literal: The Constitutional Compilation Bureau and the Imperial Consultative Assembly were to speedily compile the essentials of the outline for monarchical constitutional government, together with the various laws on parliamentary election.
translations.idiomatic: The Constitutional Compilation Bureau and the Imperial Consultative Assembly were to compile promptly the essentials of the constitutional outline and the laws governing parliamentary elections.

sentences.zh: 並將議院未開以前應籌備各事，分期擬議具奏。

translations.literal: They were also to draft by stages and memorialize in full the various matters that ought to be prepared before the parliament opens.
translations.idiomatic: They were also to draft and memorialize in stages all matters requiring preparation before parliament could open.

sentences.zh: 俟親裁後，即將開設議院年限，欽定宣布。

translations.literal: After the sovereign personally decides, the term of years for opening the parliament will then be imperially fixed and announced.
translations.idiomatic: Once the sovereign has decided, the date for opening parliament shall be proclaimed by imperial decree.

sentences.zh: 八月，憲政編查館、資政院會奏遵擬憲法議院選舉法綱要，暨議院未開以前逐年籌備事宜。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Constitutional Compilation Bureau and the Imperial Consultative Assembly jointly memorialized in compliance with the draft outline of constitutional and parliamentary election law, together with matters to be prepared year by year before the parliament opens.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the two bodies jointly memorialized the draft outline of constitutional and parliamentary election law, together with a year-by-year schedule of preparations before parliament could open.

sentences.zh: 自本年起，分九年籌備。

translations.literal: From this year, preparations were divided over nine years.
translations.idiomatic: Starting that year, preparations were spread over nine years.

sentences.zh: 其關於選舉議員者，第一年各省籌辦諮議局，第二年舉行諮議局選舉，各省一律成立，頒布資政院章程，舉行資政院選舉。

translations.literal: As for what concerned the election of members: in the first year each province was to prepare the consultative assembly; in the second year consultative assembly elections were held, all provinces established uniformly, the regulations of the Imperial Consultative Assembly promulgated, and Imperial Consultative Assembly elections held.
translations.idiomatic: Regarding member elections: year one, provinces were to prepare consultative assemblies; year two, provincial elections were to be held, all assemblies established, Imperial Consultative Assembly regulations promulgated, and its elections conducted.

sentences.zh: 第三年召集資政院議員舉行開院。

translations.literal: In the third year the members of the Imperial Consultative Assembly were convoked and the assembly opened.
translations.idiomatic: Year three, the Imperial Consultative Assembly was to convene and open its sessions.

sentences.zh: 第九年始宣布憲法，頒布議院法，暨上、下議院議員選舉法，舉行上、下議員議員選舉。

translations.literal: Only in the ninth year was the constitution to be announced, the parliamentary law promulgated, together with the election law for members of the upper and lower houses, and elections for upper and lower house members held.
translations.idiomatic: Only in year nine was the constitution to be proclaimed, parliamentary law and election laws for both houses promulgated, and elections for upper and lower house members held.

sentences.zh: 諭令京、外各衙門依限舉辦。

translations.literal: An instruction ordered all offices in the capital and outside to undertake the matter within the deadlines.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial instruction ordered all capital and provincial offices to proceed according to the schedule.

sentences.zh: 先是資政院奏擬院章目次，第二章為選舉。

translations.literal: Earlier the Imperial Consultative Assembly had memorialized the table of contents for the assembly regulations, with the second chapter on elections.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Imperial Consultative Assembly had submitted a draft outline whose second chapter dealt with elections.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年七月，資政院奏續擬院章，改訂第二章目次為議員，專詳議員資格、額數、分類、任期，而另定選舉詳細章程，以免混淆，從之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Xuantong, the Imperial Consultative Assembly memorialized continuing the draft assembly regulations, revising the second chapter heading to 'Members,' detailing exclusively member qualifications, quotas, categories, and terms of office, while separately fixing detailed election regulations to avoid confusion; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 1909 the assembly memorialized further drafts, retitling chapter two as "Members" to treat qualifications, quotas, categories, and terms in detail, with separate detailed election regulations to avoid confusion; the throne approved.

sentences.zh: 院章規定資政院議員資格，由下列各項人員年滿三十歲以上者選充。

translations.literal: The assembly regulations fixed qualifications for members of the Imperial Consultative Assembly, to be selected from persons in the following categories who were thirty years of age or above.
translations.idiomatic: The regulations stipulated that assembly members must be at least thirty years old and drawn from the following categories.

sentences.zh: 一，宗室王、公世爵；

translations.literal: One, princes of the imperial clan and hereditary noble ranks of duke and marquis;
translations.idiomatic: First, princes of the imperial clan and hereditary ranks of prince and duke;

sentences.zh: 二，滿、漢世爵；

translations.literal: Two, Manchu and Han hereditary noble ranks;
translations.idiomatic: Second, Manchu and Han hereditary nobles;

sentences.zh: 三，外籓王、公世爵；

translations.literal: Three, princes and hereditary noble ranks of the outer dependencies;
translations.idiomatic: Third, princes and hereditary nobles of the frontier dependencies;

sentences.zh: 四，宗室、覺羅；

translations.literal: Four, members of the imperial clan and gioro lineage;
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, imperial clansmen and gioro kinsmen;

sentences.zh: 五，各部、院四品以下、七品以上官，惟審判、檢察、巡警官不與；

translations.literal: Five, officials of ministries and boards from the fourth rank down to the seventh rank and above, except judicial, prosecutorial, and police officials;
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, ministry and board officials from fourth rank down through seventh rank and above, excluding judicial, prosecutorial, and police officers;

sentences.zh: 六，碩學通儒；

translations.literal: Six, eminent scholars and accomplished Confucians;
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, eminent scholars and accomplished Confucians;

sentences.zh: 七，納稅多額人；

translations.literal: Seven, persons who paid large amounts in taxes;
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, persons who had paid substantial taxes;

sentences.zh: 八，各省諮議局議員。

translations.literal: Eight, members of the provincial consultative assemblies of each province.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth, members of the provincial consultative assemblies.

sentences.zh: 定額：宗室王、公世爵十六人，滿、漢世爵十二人，外籓王、公世爵十四人，宗室、覺羅六人，各部、院官三十二人，碩學通儒十人，納稅多額者十人。

translations.literal: Fixed quotas: sixteen for princes of the imperial clan and hereditary noble ranks of duke and marquis, twelve for Manchu and Han hereditary noble ranks, fourteen for princes and hereditary noble ranks of the outer dependencies, six for imperial clan and gioro members, thirty-two for ministry and board officials, ten for eminent scholars, ten for large taxpayers.
translations.idiomatic: Quotas were fixed as follows: sixteen imperial princes and hereditary nobles of prince and duke rank; twelve Manchu and Han hereditary nobles; fourteen frontier princes and nobles; six imperial clansmen and gioro kinsmen; thirty-two ministry officials; ten eminent scholars; ten large taxpayers.

sentences.zh: 各省諮議局議員一百人。

translations.literal: One hundred members from the provincial consultative assemblies of each province.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred members from the provincial consultative assemblies.

sentences.zh: 類別為欽選、互選。

translations.literal: Categories were imperial selection and mutual selection.
translations.idiomatic: Members fell into two categories: imperial appointment and mutual election.

sentences.zh: 宗室王、公世爵，滿、漢世爵，外籓王、公世爵，宗室、覺羅，各部、院官，碩學通儒，納稅多額者，欽選。

translations.literal: Princes of the imperial clan and hereditary noble ranks, Manchu and Han hereditary noble ranks, princes and hereditary noble ranks of the outer dependencies, imperial clan and gioro members, ministry and board officials, eminent scholars, and large taxpayers were imperially selected.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial princes and nobles, Manchu and Han nobles, frontier princes and nobles, clansmen, ministry officials, eminent scholars, and large taxpayers were to be appointed by imperial selection.

sentences.zh: 各省諮議局議員互選。

translations.literal: Members of the provincial consultative assemblies were mutually selected.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial consultative assembly members were to be chosen by mutual election.

sentences.zh: 任期三年，任滿一律改選。

translations.literal: The term was three years; when the term expired, all were uniformly re-elected.
translations.idiomatic: Terms were three years; at expiry all members were to be re-elected.

sentences.zh: 九月，資政院會奏資政院議員選舉章程，疏言：「資政院議員選任之法，大別為欽選、互選二者，各有取義。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Imperial Consultative Assembly jointly memorialized the regulations for election of members of the Imperial Consultative Assembly, stating in the memorial: 'The methods for selecting and appointing members of the Imperial Consultative Assembly are broadly divided into imperial selection and mutual selection, each with its rationale.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the assembly jointly memorialized its election regulations, observing: "Methods for appointing assembly members fall broadly into imperial selection and mutual election, each with its own rationale.

sentences.zh: 而欽選議員名位有崇卑，人數有多寡，當因宜定制，取便推行。

translations.literal: Among imperially selected members, rank and title have high and low, and numbers have many and few; regulations should be tailored to circumstances for convenient implementation.
translations.idiomatic: Among imperial appointees, rank varies from high to low and numbers from many to few; rules must be adapted to circumstance for ease of implementation.

sentences.zh: 宗室王、公世爵，滿、漢世爵及外籓王、公世爵，階級既高，計數較少，應開列全單，恭候簡命。

translations.literal: Princes of the imperial clan and hereditary noble ranks, Manchu and Han hereditary noble ranks, and princes and hereditary noble ranks of the outer dependencies, their ranks being already high and their numbers comparatively few, ought to have the full list drawn up and respectfully await simplified appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial princes and nobles, Manchu and Han nobles, and frontier princes and nobles rank high and are few in number; the full eligible list should be submitted for the throne's direct appointment.

sentences.zh: 宗室、覺羅，各部、院官及納稅多額者，合格人數，與議員定額比例，多少懸殊。

translations.literal: For imperial clan and gioro members, ministry and board officials, and large taxpayers, the number of qualified persons compared to the fixed quota of members differs greatly in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: For clansmen, ministry officials, and large taxpayers, the pool of eligible persons bears no fixed proportion to the number of seats.

sentences.zh: 考外國上院制，敕任議員多經互選。

translations.literal: Considering the upper-house systems of foreign countries, members appointed by imperial command mostly pass through mutual selection.
translations.idiomatic: In foreign upper houses, members appointed by the crown commonly pass through prior mutual election.

sentences.zh: 擬略師其意，於欽選之前，舉行互選。

translations.literal: We propose roughly to follow their intent and hold mutual selection before imperial selection.
translations.idiomatic: We propose to follow their example in holding mutual election before imperial appointment.

sentences.zh: 各照定額，增列多名。

translations.literal: For each according to the fixed quota, additional names were to be listed.
translations.idiomatic: For each quota, additional candidates were to be listed.

sentences.zh: 好惡既卜諸輿情，用舍仍歸於宸斷。

translations.literal: Likes and dislikes having been divined through public opinion, employment or dismissal still returns to the sovereign's decision.
translations.idiomatic: Public sentiment would thus be tested, yet the final choice would still rest with the throne.

sentences.zh: 其碩學通儒，資格確定較難，人數調查不易，互選勢所難行。

translations.literal: As for eminent scholars and accomplished Confucians, qualifications are harder to fix with certainty, numbers are not easy to investigate, and mutual selection is by force of circumstance difficult to carry out.
translations.idiomatic: For eminent scholars, qualifications are hard to define precisely, numbers hard to ascertain, and mutual election impracticable.

sentences.zh: 擬略仿從前保薦鴻博之例，寬取嚴用，以蒐訪之任，寄諸庶官。

translations.literal: We propose roughly to imitate the former precedent of recommending erudite scholars, taking broadly and using strictly, entrusting the task of search and inquiry to ordinary officials.
translations.idiomatic: We propose to follow the precedent of the erudite scholar recommendations: cast the net wide but select strictly, entrusting the search to officials throughout the bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 抉擇之權，授諸學部。

translations.literal: The authority of selection was entrusted to the Ministry of Education.
translations.idiomatic: The power of final selection was vested in the Ministry of Education.

sentences.zh: 仍寬定開列名數，冀不失欽選之本旨。

translations.literal: Still, names and numbers to be listed were broadly fixed, hoping not to lose the original intent of imperial selection.
translations.idiomatic: A generous list of names was still to be submitted, so as not to depart from the spirit of imperial appointment.

sentences.zh: 以上各項，略采各國上院辦法，為建設上議院之基礎。

translations.literal: The above items roughly adopt the methods of upper houses of various countries as the foundation for building an upper house.
translations.idiomatic: All of the above roughly follow foreign upper-house practice as the foundation for building an upper chamber.

sentences.zh: 而資政院兼有下院性質，不能無民選議員，與欽選相對待。

translations.literal: Yet the Imperial Consultative Assembly also partakes of the character of a lower house; it cannot be without members popularly elected, set in contrast to imperial selection.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the assembly also partakes of a lower-house character; it cannot do without popularly chosen members to balance imperial appointment.

sentences.zh: 特以諮議局為資政院半數議員之互選機關，諮議局議員本由各省合格紳民複選而來，則諮議局公推遞升之資政院議員，即不啻人民間接所選舉。

translations.literal: Specifically, the consultative assembly serves as the mutual-selection organ for half the assembly's members; since consultative members themselves come from secondary election by qualified gentry and commoners in each province, assembly members publicly nominated and advanced from consultatives are virtually no different from indirect election by the people.
translations.idiomatic: The consultative assembly was made the mutual-election body for half the assembly's seats; since its members were themselves chosen by qualified provincial gentry, members it nominated upward to the assembly were in effect indirectly elected by the people.

sentences.zh: 公推遞升之標準，不能不以得票多寡為衡。

translations.literal: The standard for public nomination and advancement cannot but take the number of votes received as the measure.
translations.idiomatic: Public nomination must be measured by the number of votes received.

sentences.zh: 但監督權屬於督、撫，非經覆定，不令遽膺是選。

translations.literal: But supervisory authority belongs to governors and governors-general; without review and confirmation, one is not permitted hastily to undertake this selection.
translations.idiomatic: Supervision rested with governors, however, and no one could take up the selection without their review and confirmation.

sentences.zh: 既與欽選大權示有區別，自與下院要義不相背馳。

translations.literal: Since it shows a distinction from the great power of imperial selection, it naturally does not run counter to the essential meaning of a lower house.
translations.idiomatic: This marked a distinction from imperial appointment while remaining true to the spirit of a lower house.

sentences.zh: 」詔如所議行。

translations.literal: ' An edict approved implementation as deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne ordered the proposal carried out.

sentences.zh: 資政院議員選舉章程之規定，宗室王、公世爵，列爵凡十二：一，和碩親王；

translations.literal: The regulations of the election charter for members of the Imperial Consultative Assembly fixed that for princes of the imperial clan and hereditary noble ranks, the listed ranks totaled twelve: one, hošo-i cin wang (prince of the first rank);
translations.idiomatic: The election regulations for imperial princes and hereditary nobles listed twelve ranks: first, Prince of the First Rank;

sentences.zh: 二，多羅郡王；

translations.literal: two, doro-i giyūn wang (prince of the second rank);
translations.idiomatic: second, Prince of the Second Rank;

sentences.zh: 三，多羅貝勒；

translations.literal: three, doro-i beile (prince of the third rank);
translations.idiomatic: third, Prince of the Third Rank;

sentences.zh: 四，固山貝子；

translations.literal: four, gūsai beizi (prince of the fourth rank);
translations.idiomatic: fourth, Prince of the Fourth Rank;

sentences.zh: 五，奉恩鎮國公；

translations.literal: five, feng'en zhenguo gong (duke who pacifies the state by imperial grace);
translations.idiomatic: fifth, Duke Who Pacifies the State by Imperial Grace;

sentences.zh: 六，奉恩輔國公；

translations.literal: six, feng'en fuguo gong (duke who assists the state by imperial grace);
translations.idiomatic: sixth, Duke Who Assists the State by Imperial Grace;

sentences.zh: 七，不入八分鎮國公；

translations.literal: seven, buru jakūn gūsai zhenguo gong (duke who pacifies the state, not entered into the eight privileges);
translations.idiomatic: seventh, Duke Who Pacifies the State, Outside the Eight Privileges;

sentences.zh: 八，不入八分輔國公；

translations.literal: eight, buru jakūn gūsai fuguo gong (duke who assists the state, not entered into the eight privileges);
translations.idiomatic: eighth, Duke Who Assists the State, Outside the Eight Privileges;

sentences.zh: 九，鎮國將軍；

translations.literal: nine, zhenguo jiangjun (general who pacifies the state);
translations.idiomatic: ninth, General Who Pacifies the State;

sentences.zh: 十輔國將軍；

translations.literal: ten, fuguo jiangjun (general who assists the state);
translations.idiomatic: tenth, General Who Assists the State;

sentences.zh: 十一，奉國將軍；

translations.literal: eleven, fengguo jiangjun (general who supports the state);
translations.idiomatic: eleventh, General Who Supports the State;

sentences.zh: 十二，奉恩將軍。

translations.literal: twelve, feng'en jiangjun (general by imperial grace).
translations.idiomatic: twelfth, General by Imperial Grace.

sentences.zh: 按院章定額分配，自和碩親王至奉恩輔國公十人，自不入八分鎮國公至奉恩將軍六人。

translations.literal: According to the fixed quotas in the assembly regulations, from hošo-i cin wang through feng'en fuguo gong ten persons, from buru jakūn gūsai zhenguo gong through feng'en jiangjun six persons.
translations.idiomatic: Quotas under the assembly regulations allotted ten seats from Prince of the First Rank through Duke Who Assists the State by Imperial Grace, and six from the lower ducal ranks through General by Imperial Grace.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢世爵，以滿洲、蒙古、漢軍旗員及漢員三等男以上以之爵級為限，按定額分配。

translations.literal: For Manchu and Han hereditary noble ranks, limited to bannermen of the Manchu, Mongol, and Chinese Banners and Han officials of third-rank baron and above, quotas were allocated according to the fixed numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu and Han hereditary nobles were limited to Manchu, Mongol, and Chinese Bannermen and Han officials of baron third rank and above, with seats allocated by fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 三等侯以上八人，一等伯至三等男四人。

translations.literal: Third-rank marquis and above eight persons, first-rank baron through third-rank baron four persons.
translations.idiomatic: Eight seats for marquis third rank and above; four for baron first rank through baron third rank.

sentences.zh: 外籓王、公世爵，凡下列蒙古、回部、西藏各爵：一，汗；

translations.literal: For princes and hereditary noble ranks of the outer dependencies, all the following ranks of Mongolia, Muslim regions, and Tibet: one, khan;
translations.idiomatic: Frontier princes and nobles comprised the following Mongol, Muslim, and Tibetan ranks: first, khan;

sentences.zh: 二，親王；

translations.literal: two, wang (prince);
translations.idiomatic: second, prince;

sentences.zh: 三，郡王；

translations.literal: three, jun wang (commandery prince);
translations.idiomatic: third, commandery prince;

sentences.zh: 四，貝勒；

translations.literal: four, beile;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, beile;

sentences.zh: 五，貝子；

translations.literal: five, beizi;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, beizi;

sentences.zh: 六，鎮國公；

translations.literal: six, zhenguo gong;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, Duke Who Pacifies the State;

sentences.zh: 七，輔國公。

translations.literal: seven, fuguo gong.
translations.idiomatic: seventh, Duke Who Assists the State.

sentences.zh: 按定額分配。

translations.literal: Allocated according to fixed quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Seats were allocated by fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 內蒙古六盟，盟各一人；

translations.literal: The six leagues of Inner Mongolia, one person from each league;
translations.idiomatic: The six Inner Mongolian leagues, one each;

sentences.zh: 外蒙古四盟，盟各一人；

translations.literal: the four leagues of Outer Mongolia, one person from each league;
translations.idiomatic: the four Outer Mongolian leagues, one each;

sentences.zh: 科布多及新疆所屬蒙古各旗一人；

translations.literal: one person from the Mongol banners subordinate to Kobdo and Xinjiang;
translations.idiomatic: one from the Mongol banners of Kobdo and Xinjiang;

sentences.zh: 青海所屬蒙古各旗一人；

translations.literal: one person from the Mongol banners subordinate to Qinghai;
translations.idiomatic: one from the Mongol banners of Qinghai;

sentences.zh: 回部一人；

translations.literal: one person from the Muslim regions;
translations.idiomatic: one from the Muslim regions;

sentences.zh: 西藏一人。

translations.literal: one person from Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: one from Tibet.

sentences.zh: 凡各項世爵年滿三十歲以上，未奉特旨停止差俸，及因疾病或事故自請開去一切差使者，均得選充資政院議員。

translations.literal: All persons in the various hereditary noble ranks who were thirty years of age or above, had not received a special edict stopping their assignment stipends, and had not on account of illness or circumstances voluntarily requested removal from all assignments, were all eligible to be selected as members of the Imperial Consultative Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: Any holder of these hereditary ranks aged thirty or above who had not been stripped of stipends by special edict and had not voluntarily relinquished all assignments for illness or other cause was eligible for election to the assembly.

sentences.zh: 每屆選舉，資政院於前一年九月行知宗人府、各該管衙門、理籓部，分別查明合格者，造具清冊，於選舉年分二月以前，咨送資政院。

translations.literal: For each election, in the ninth month of the preceding year the Imperial Consultative Assembly notified the Imperial Clan Court, each supervising office, and the Court of Colonial Affairs to investigate qualified persons separately, compile clear registers, and transmit them to the assembly before the second month of the election year.
translations.idiomatic: Before each election, in the ninth month of the prior year the assembly notified the Imperial Clan Court, relevant offices, and the Court of Colonial Affairs to verify eligibles, compile registers, and forward them by the second month of the election year.

sentences.zh: 由院分別開單，於三月以前，奏請按額欽選。

translations.literal: The assembly was separately to draw up lists and, before the third month, memorialize requesting imperial selection according to quota.
translations.idiomatic: The assembly would draw up separate lists and memorialize for imperial appointment by quota before the third month.

sentences.zh: 其宗室王、公，滿、漢世爵，現任軍機大臣，參豫政務大臣，及資政院總裁、副總裁者，無庸選充。

translations.literal: Imperial princes and nobles, Manchu and Han hereditary nobles who were currently Grand Councillors, ministers participating in government affairs, and presidents and vice-presidents of the Imperial Consultative Assembly need not be selected.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial princes and nobles serving as Grand Councillors, ministers participating in government affairs, or as president or vice-president of the assembly were exempt from election.

sentences.zh: 有缺額時，資政院隨時行知各該衙門，修正清冊。

translations.literal: When there were vacancies, the Imperial Consultative Assembly at any time notified the relevant offices to revise the clear registers.
translations.idiomatic: When vacancies arose, the assembly notified the relevant offices at once to revise the registers.

sentences.zh: 按爵級或部落應選充者，奏請欽選補足之。

translations.literal: Those who ought to be selected according to rank or tribe were to be memorialized for imperial selection to fill the quota.
translations.idiomatic: Vacancies were to be filled by memorializing for imperial appointment according to rank or tribe.

sentences.zh: 宗室、覺羅，凡男子年滿三十歲以上，無下列情事者，得選充資政院議員：一，曾處圈禁或發遣者；

translations.literal: For imperial clan and gioro members, all males thirty years of age or above who had none of the following circumstances were eligible: one, had been placed in house arrest or banishment;
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansmen and gioro kinsmen aged thirty or above were eligible unless: first, they had been confined or banished;

sentences.zh: 二，失財產上信用被人控實未清結者；

translations.literal: two, had lost credit in property matters and been reported with facts verified but not yet settled;
translations.idiomatic: second, they had lost financial credit and faced verified but unsettled charges;

sentences.zh: 三，吸食鴉片者；

translations.literal: three, used opium;
translations.idiomatic: third, they used opium;

sentences.zh: 四，有心疾者；

translations.literal: four, had mental illness;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, they suffered mental illness;

sentences.zh: 五，不識文義者。

translations.literal: five, did not know written language.
translations.idiomatic: fifth, they were illiterate.

sentences.zh: 其現任三品以上職官，審判、檢察、巡警官，及現充海、陸軍軍人者，無庸選充。

translations.literal: Those currently holding offices of the third rank and above, judicial, prosecutorial, and police officials, and those currently serving as naval or army military personnel need not be selected.
translations.idiomatic: Those holding third-rank posts or above, judicial, prosecutorial, or police offices, or active military service were exempt.

sentences.zh: 按定額分配，宗室四人，覺羅二人，由各該合格人先行互選。

translations.literal: According to fixed quotas, four for the imperial clan and two for gioro, with prior mutual selection by the qualified persons of each category.
translations.idiomatic: Quotas fixed four imperial clansmen and two gioro kinsmen, chosen first by mutual election among eligibles.

sentences.zh: 於選舉年分二月初一日，在京師及奉天府行之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the second month of the election year, this was conducted in the capital and in Fengtian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Elections were held on the first day of the second month in the capital and in Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 京師以宗人府堂官為監督，奉天以東三省總督為監督。

translations.literal: In the capital the supervising official was a director of the Imperial Clan Court; in Fengtian the governor-general of the Three Eastern Provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the capital the Imperial Clan Court supervised; in Fengtian, the governor-general of the Northeast.

sentences.zh: 每屆互選，資政院於前一年九月行知互選監督，照章舉行。

translations.literal: For each mutual election, in the ninth month of the preceding year the Imperial Consultative Assembly notified the mutual-election supervisor to conduct it according to regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Before each mutual election the assembly notified supervisors in the ninth month of the prior year to proceed according to regulations.

sentences.zh: 設互選管理員，掌調查互選人，管理投票、開票、檢票等事宜。

translations.literal: Mutual-election administrators were established, in charge of investigating mutual electors and managing voting, opening ballots, checking ballots, and other matters.
translations.idiomatic: Mutual-election administrators were appointed to verify electors and manage balloting, counting, and inspection.

sentences.zh: 由互選管理員查明合格人員，造具互選人名冊，先期呈由互選監督宣示公眾。

translations.literal: The mutual-election administrators investigated qualified persons, compiled registers of mutual electors, and in advance submitted them to the mutual-election supervisor for public announcement.
translations.idiomatic: Administrators verified eligibles, compiled voter rolls, and submitted them in advance to supervisors for public announcement.

sentences.zh: 如本人認為錯誤遺漏，得於宣示期內，呈請互選監督更正補入。

translations.literal: If the person himself considered there were errors or omissions, he might within the announcement period petition the mutual-election supervisor for correction and supplementation.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who believed the roll contained errors or omissions might petition the supervisor during the announcement period for correction.

sentences.zh: 經批駁者，不得瀆請。

translations.literal: Those whose petitions were rejected might not petition importunately.
translations.idiomatic: Rejected petitions could not be repeated.

sentences.zh: 互選選舉人及被選舉人，均以列名互選人名冊者為限。

translations.literal: Mutual-election electors and candidates were limited to those listed on the register of mutual electors.
translations.idiomatic: Only persons on the mutual-elector roll could vote or be voted for.

sentences.zh: 屆期互選監督應親蒞投票所，或派員監察之。

translations.literal: When the time arrived, the mutual-election supervisor ought personally to attend the polling place or dispatch personnel to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: On election day supervisors were to attend the polls in person or send observers.

sentences.zh: 互選人應親赴投票所自行投票，用記名單記法。

translations.literal: Mutual electors ought personally to go to the polling place and vote themselves, using the method of signed individual ballots.
translations.idiomatic: Electors were to vote in person at the polls by signed ballot.

sentences.zh: 互選人有因職務或因疾病、事故不能親赴投票者，得就互選人內委託一人代行投票，應由本人親書密封署名畫押，連同委託憑證，送致受託人。

translations.literal: Mutual electors who because of duties or illness or circumstances could not personally go to vote might entrust one person among the mutual electors to vote on their behalf; they were to seal, sign, and mark the ballot in their own hand, together with credentials of entrustment, and deliver them to the trustee.
translations.idiomatic: Electors unable to attend because of duty, illness, or other cause might entrust another elector to vote for them, providing a sealed, signed ballot and written authorization.

sentences.zh: 該受託人應將密封及委託憑證臨時向互選監督呈驗，方許代投。

translations.literal: The trustee was to present the sealed ballot and credentials of entrustment on the spot to the mutual-election supervisor for inspection before proxy voting was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The trustee had to present the sealed ballot and authorization to the supervisor on the spot before casting a proxy vote.

sentences.zh: 以得票較多數者為當選。

translations.literal: Whoever received the greater number of votes was elected.
translations.idiomatic: The candidate with the most votes was elected.

sentences.zh: 互選當選人額數，各以議員定額之十倍為準。

translations.literal: The number of mutual-election winners was in each case set at ten times the fixed quota of members.
translations.idiomatic: The number elected at mutual election was ten times the seat quota in each category.

sentences.zh: 互選告竣，互選監督即日將當選人名榜示投票所。

translations.literal: When mutual election was concluded, the mutual-election supervisor on the same day posted the names of the elected at the polling place.
translations.idiomatic: When voting ended, supervisors posted the winners' names at the polls the same day.

sentences.zh: 不原應選者，得於三日內呈明互選監督撤銷，將得票次多數者補入。

translations.literal: Those unwilling to accept election might within three days explain to the mutual-election supervisor for cancellation, and the person with the next greatest number of votes was to be added.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone unwilling to serve might decline within three days, whereupon the runner-up would take the place.

sentences.zh: 互選管理員造具當選人名冊，連同票紙，呈由互選監督咨送資政院，由院將當選人名及得票數目，於選舉年分三月以前，奏請按額欽選。

translations.literal: The mutual-election administrators compiled registers of the elected, together with ballot papers, and submitted them through the mutual-election supervisor to the Imperial Consultative Assembly; the assembly was to list the names of the elected and vote counts and, before the third month of the election year, memorialize requesting imperial selection according to quota.
translations.idiomatic: Administrators compiled registers of winners with the ballots and forwarded them through supervisors to the assembly, which by the third month would memorialize for imperial appointment by quota, listing names and vote counts.

sentences.zh: 有缺額時，資政院隨時將本屆當選人開單奏請欽選補足之。

translations.literal: When there were vacancies, the Imperial Consultative Assembly at any time drew up a list of that term's elected and memorialized requesting imperial selection to fill them.
translations.idiomatic: Vacancies were filled from that term's elected list by memorializing for imperial appointment.

sentences.zh: 本屆當選人數不足議員缺額之三倍時，應舉行臨時互選，一切照尋常互選辦理。

translations.literal: When the number of elected in that term fell short of three times the member vacancies, a provisional mutual election was to be held, with everything conducted according to ordinary mutual election.
translations.idiomatic: If winners numbered fewer than three times the vacancies, a special mutual election was held under the ordinary rules.

sentences.zh: 各部、院官，以下列各官為限：一，內閣侍讀學士以下，中書以上；

translations.literal: Ministry and board officials were limited to the following offices: one, from Reader of the Grand Secretariat down through Grand Secretary and above;
translations.idiomatic: Ministry and board officials were limited to: first, from Reader of the Grand Secretariat through Grand Secretary and above;

sentences.zh: 二，翰林院侍讀學士以下，庶吉士以上；

translations.literal: two, from Reader of the Hanlin Academy down through Bachelor of the Hanlin Academy and above;
translations.idiomatic: second, from Hanlin Reader through Hanlin Bachelor and above;

sentences.zh: 三，各部左、右參議以下，七品小京官以上；

translations.literal: three, from Left and Right Counsellor of each ministry down through seventh-rank junior capital officials and above;
translations.idiomatic: third, from ministry counsellors through seventh-rank capital officials and above;

sentences.zh: 四，掌印給事中、給事中及監察御史。

translations.literal: four, Sealing Censor, Censor, and Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: fourth, sealing censors, censors, and investigating censors.

sentences.zh: 各官以年滿三十歲以上，具下列資格之一，得選充資政院議員：一，現任實缺者；

translations.literal: Each official, being thirty years of age or above and possessing one of the following qualifications, was eligible: one, currently holding a substantive vacancy;
translations.idiomatic: Officials aged thirty or above with one of the following qualifications were eligible: first, holding a substantive post;

sentences.zh: 二，曾任實缺未休致、革職者；

translations.literal: two, formerly held a substantive vacancy and had not retired or been dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: second, formerly held a substantive post and had neither retired nor been dismissed;

sentences.zh: 三，奉特旨署理或奏署者；

translations.literal: three, acting by special edict or memorialized appointment;
translations.idiomatic: third, acting by special edict or memorialized appointment;

sentences.zh: 四，奉特旨候補、補用、選用或學習行走者；

translations.literal: four, awaiting appointment, supplementary appointment, selection, or study assignment by special edict;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, awaiting appointment, supplementary use, selection, or probation by special edict;

sentences.zh: 五，其餘候補滿三年以上者。

translations.literal: five, all others who had awaited appointment for three years or more.
translations.idiomatic: fifth, all others who had awaited appointment for three years or more.

sentences.zh: 由合格人先行互選，於選舉年分二月初一日在京師行之，以都察院堂官為監督。

translations.literal: Qualified persons were first to hold mutual selection, conducted in the capital on the first day of the second month of the election year, with a director of the Censorate as supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Eligibles held mutual election in the capital on the first day of the second month, supervised by a Censorate director.

sentences.zh: 互選當選人額數，以議員定額之五倍為率，各部、院官選充資政院議員者，於院內職權，本衙門長官不得干涉。

translations.literal: The number of mutual-election winners was at the rate of five times the fixed quota of members; ministry and board officials selected as assembly members—in their powers within the assembly, the heads of their original offices might not interfere.
translations.idiomatic: Winners numbered five times the seat quota; ministry officials elected to the assembly were not subject to interference by their department heads in assembly affairs.

sentences.zh: 其因升轉降調致失原定資格者，即同時失資政院議員之資格。

translations.literal: Those who through promotion, transfer, demotion, or reassignment lost their original qualifications simultaneously lost qualification as assembly members.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who lost eligibility through promotion, transfer, or demotion simultaneously lost membership qualification.

sentences.zh: 所有舉行互選、奏請欽選、補足缺額各辦法，與宗室、覺羅選舉同。

translations.literal: All methods for holding mutual election, memorializing for imperial selection, and filling vacancies were the same as for imperial clan and gioro election.
translations.idiomatic: All procedures for mutual election, imperial appointment, and filling vacancies followed the same rules as for clansmen.

sentences.zh: 碩學通儒資格凡四：一，不由考試、特旨賞授清秩者；

translations.literal: Qualifications for eminent scholars and accomplished Confucians totaled four: one, those awarded Qing official rank by special edict without examination;
translations.idiomatic: Eminent scholars qualified in four ways: first, those granted Qing official rank by special edict without examination;

sentences.zh: 二，著書有裨政治或學術者；

translations.literal: two, those whose writings benefited politics or scholarship;
translations.idiomatic: second, those whose writings advanced politics or scholarship;

sentences.zh: 三，有入通儒院之資格者；

translations.literal: three, those with qualifications to enter the Academy of Eminent Confucians;
translations.idiomatic: third, those qualified for the Academy of Eminent Confucians;

sentences.zh: 四，充高等及專門學堂主要科目教習五年以上著有成績者。

translations.literal: four, those who had served as instructors in major subjects at higher and specialized schools for five years or more with distinguished achievements.
translations.idiomatic: fourth, those who had taught major subjects at higher or specialized schools for five years or more with distinguished results.

sentences.zh: 凡年滿三十歲以上，具前列資格之一，均得選充資政院議員。

translations.literal: All who were thirty years of age or above and possessed one of the foregoing qualifications were eligible to be selected as assembly members.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone aged thirty or above meeting one of these qualifications was eligible for election.

sentences.zh: 每屆選舉，資政院於前一年九月行知學部，由部通行京堂以上官、翰林、給事中、御史、各省督、撫、提學使、出使各國大臣，各蒐訪一人或二人，開具事實，保送學部審查。

translations.literal: For each election, in the ninth month of the preceding year the Imperial Consultative Assembly notified the Ministry of Education, which circulated capital officials of jingtang rank and above, Hanlin academicians, censors, investigating censors, provincial governors, education commissioners, and ministers abroad, each to search out one or two persons, set forth the facts, and recommend them to the Ministry of Education for review.
translations.idiomatic: Before each election the assembly notified the Ministry of Education in the ninth month of the prior year; the ministry then asked capital officials, Hanlin scholars, censors, governors, education commissioners, and ministers abroad each to nominate one or two candidates with supporting facts for ministry review.

sentences.zh: 擇定合格得保多者三十人，作為碩學通儒議員之被選人。

translations.literal: Thirty persons were selected who were qualified and had received the most recommendations, to serve as candidates for eminent-scholar members.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry selected thirty qualified candidates with the most recommendations as nominees for eminent-scholar seats.

sentences.zh: 於選舉年分二月以前，咨送資政院。

translations.literal: Before the second month of the election year, they were transmitted to the Imperial Consultative Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: They were forwarded to the assembly before the second month of the election year.

sentences.zh: 由院將被選人姓名及原保人姓名官職開單，於三月以前，奏請按額欽選。

translations.literal: The assembly was to draw up a list of candidates' names and the names and offices of their original recommenders and, before the third month, memorialize requesting imperial selection according to quota.
translations.idiomatic: The assembly listed nominees and recommenders and memorialized for imperial appointment by quota before the third month.

sentences.zh: 有缺額時，資政院隨時將本屆被選人照章奏請欽選補足之。

translations.literal: When there were vacancies, the Imperial Consultative Assembly at any time memorialized from that term's candidates according to regulations requesting imperial selection to fill them.
translations.idiomatic: Vacancies were filled from that term's nominees by memorializing according to regulations.

sentences.zh: 本屆被選人數不足議員缺額之三倍時，應另行保送。

translations.literal: When the number of candidates in that term fell short of three times the member vacancies, new recommendations were to be submitted separately.
translations.idiomatic: If nominees numbered fewer than three times the vacancies, fresh recommendations were required.

sentences.zh: 納稅多額人，以下列資格為限：一，男子照地方自治章程有選民權者；

translations.literal: Large taxpayers were limited to the following qualifications: one, males who under local self-government regulations possessed suffrage;
translations.idiomatic: Large taxpayers qualified as follows: first, men with suffrage under local self-government regulations;

sentences.zh: 二，年納正稅或地方公益捐，在所居省分佔額較多者。

translations.literal: two, those who paid regular taxes or local public-welfare contributions annually in amounts comparatively large within the province where they resided.
translations.idiomatic: second, those who paid comparatively large annual regular taxes or local public contributions in their province of residence.

sentences.zh: 凡具此資格，年滿三十歲以上，得選充資政院議員。

translations.literal: All who possessed these qualifications and were thirty years of age or above were eligible to be selected as assembly members.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone meeting these qualifications and aged thirty or above was eligible for election.

sentences.zh: 由合格人先行互選，於選舉年分二月初一日在各省城行之，以布政使或民政使為監督。

translations.literal: Qualified persons were first to hold mutual selection, conducted on the first day of the second month of the election year in each provincial capital, with the provincial treasurer or civil affairs commissioner as supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Eligibles held mutual election on the first day of the second month in each provincial capital, supervised by the provincial treasurer or civil affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 每屆互選，資政院於前一年九月行知各省督、撫，照章舉行。

translations.literal: For each mutual election, in the ninth month of the preceding year the Imperial Consultative Assembly notified each provincial governor and governor-general to conduct it according to regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Before each mutual election the assembly notified provincial governors in the ninth month of the prior year to proceed according to regulations.

sentences.zh: 互選監督會同商務總會總理、協理，遴派互選管理員。

translations.literal: The mutual-election supervisor, together with the director and associate director of the Chamber of Commerce, selected and appointed mutual-election administrators.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisors, together with chamber of commerce directors, appointed mutual-election administrators.

sentences.zh: 互選辦法與普通互選同。

translations.literal: The methods of mutual election were the same as ordinary mutual election.
translations.idiomatic: Mutual election followed the ordinary procedures.

sentences.zh: 互選人額數。

translations.literal: The number of mutual electors.
translations.idiomatic: The number of mutual electors:

sentences.zh: 每省以二十人為限。

translations.literal: Each province was limited to twenty persons.
translations.idiomatic: was limited to twenty per province.

sentences.zh: 投票用記名連記法，以得票過互選人數三分之一者為當選。

translations.literal: Voting used the signed cumulative-ballot method; whoever received more than one-third of the mutual electors was elected.
translations.idiomatic: Voting used signed cumulative ballots; a candidate needed more than one-third of the electors' votes to win.

sentences.zh: 互選當選人額數，以互選人額數十分之一為率。

translations.literal: The number of mutual-election winners was at the rate of one-tenth of the number of mutual electors.
translations.idiomatic: Winners numbered one-tenth of the mutual electors.

sentences.zh: 如當選人不足定額，就得票較多者，令互選人再行投票，以足額為止。

translations.literal: If winners fell short of the quota, those with more votes were to have mutual electors vote again until the quota was filled.
translations.idiomatic: If winners fell short of quota, electors revoted among leading candidates until seats were filled.

sentences.zh: 其得票及格、額滿見遺者，作為候補當選人。

translations.literal: Those who met the vote threshold but were passed over when quotas were full served as alternate winners.
translations.idiomatic: Qualified candidates passed over when quotas were full became alternates.

sentences.zh: 當選人不原應選，得呈明互選監督撤銷，以候補當選人依次遞補。

translations.literal: Winners unwilling to serve might petition the mutual-election supervisor for cancellation, with alternate winners filling in by order.
translations.idiomatic: Winners who declined could petition supervisors; alternates filled seats in order.

sentences.zh: 互選管理員造具當選人及候補當選人名冊，連同票紙，呈由互選督申送本省督、撫，各督、撫將當選人姓名及得票數目咨送資政院，由院開單，於三月以前，奏請按額欽選。

translations.literal: Mutual-election administrators compiled registers of winners and alternates with ballot papers and submitted them through the mutual-election supervisor to the provincial governor; each governor forwarded winners' names and vote counts to the Imperial Consultative Assembly, which drew up lists and before the third month memorialized for imperial selection by quota.
translations.idiomatic: Administrators compiled registers of winners and alternates with ballots and submitted them through supervisors to provincial governors, who forwarded names and vote counts to the assembly for imperial appointment by quota before the third month.

sentences.zh: 有缺額時，資政院隨時將本屆當選人開單奏請欽選補足之。

translations.literal: When there were vacancies, the Imperial Consultative Assembly at any time drew up a list of that term's elected and memorialized requesting imperial selection to fill them.
translations.idiomatic: Vacancies were filled from that term's winners by memorializing for imperial appointment.

sentences.zh: 本屆當選人不足議員缺額之三倍時，以候補當選人遞補。

translations.literal: When winners of that term fell short of three times the member vacancies, alternate winners filled in by order.
translations.idiomatic: If winners numbered less than three times the vacant seats, alternates filled them in order.

sentences.zh: 候補當選人數不敷時，舉行臨時互選。

translations.literal: When alternate winners were insufficient in number, a temporary mutual election was held.
translations.idiomatic: If alternates ran short, a special mutual election was held.

sentences.zh: 各省諮議局互選諮政院議員，按定額分配：奉天三人，吉林二人，黑龍江二人，順直九人，江蘇七人，安徽五人，江西六人，浙江七人，福建四人，湖北五人，湖南五人，山東六人，河南五人，山西五人，陝西四人，甘肅三人，新疆二人，四川六人，廣東五人，廣西三人，雲南四人，貴州二人。

translations.literal: Each province's consultative assembly mutual-elected Imperial Consultative Assembly members according to fixed quotas: Fengtian three, Jilin two, Heilongjiang two, Zhili nine, Jiangsu seven, Anhui five, Jiangxi six, Zhejiang seven, Fujian four, Hubei five, Hunan five, Shandong six, Henan five, Shanxi five, Shaanxi four, Gansu three, Xinjiang two, Sichuan six, Guangdong five, Guangxi three, Yunnan four, Guizhou two.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial consultative assemblies mutual-elected assembly members by fixed quota: Fengtian 3, Jilin 2, Heilongjiang 2, Zhili 9, Jiangsu 7, Anhui 5, Jiangxi 6, Zhejiang 7, Fujian 4, Hubei 5, Hunan 5, Shandong 6, Henan 5, Shanxi 5, Shaanxi 4, Gansu 3, Xinjiang 2, Sichuan 6, Guangdong 5, Guangxi 3, Yunnan 4, Guizhou 2.

sentences.zh: 互選於選舉年分前一年十月十一日，在各省諮議局行之。

translations.literal: Mutual election was held in each province's consultative assembly on the eleventh day of the tenth month of the year before the election year.
translations.idiomatic: Mutual elections were held in provincial consultative assemblies on the tenth month's eleventh day, one year before the election year.

sentences.zh: 以督、撫為監督。

translations.literal: The governor served as supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial governors supervised.

sentences.zh: 每屆互選，資政院於前一年九月行知各互選監督，照章舉行。

translations.literal: Each term, in the ninth month of the prior year the Imperial Consultative Assembly notified each mutual-election supervisor to proceed according to the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Before each term, the assembly notified supervisors in the ninth month of the prior year to proceed by rule.

sentences.zh: 屆期互選監督親蒞監察之。

translations.literal: When the date arrived, the mutual-election supervisor personally attended to oversee it.
translations.idiomatic: On election day, supervisors attended in person.

sentences.zh: 投票、開票、檢票等事，由諮議局辦事處管理。

translations.literal: Voting, ballot opening, ballot checking, and the like were managed by the consultative assembly office.
translations.idiomatic: The consultative assembly office managed voting, counting, and ballot inspection.

sentences.zh: 適用普通互選規則，互選選舉人及被選舉人均以該省諮議局議員為限。

translations.literal: The ordinary mutual-election rules applied; both mutual electors and candidates were limited to that province's consultative assembly members.
translations.idiomatic: Ordinary mutual-election rules applied; only that province's consultative assembly members could vote or stand.

sentences.zh: 投票用記名連記法，以得票過互選人半數者為當選。

translations.literal: Voting used the signed cumulative-ballot method; whoever received more than half the mutual electors' votes was elected.
translations.idiomatic: Voting used signed cumulative ballots; candidates needed a majority of electors' votes to win.

sentences.zh: 互選當選人額數，以各該省議員額數之二倍為率。

translations.literal: The number of mutual-election winners was at the rate of twice each province's member quota.
translations.idiomatic: Winners numbered twice each province's member quota.

sentences.zh: 如當選人不足定額，就得票較多者，令互選人再行投票，以足額為止。

translations.literal: If winners fell short of the quota, those with more votes were to have mutual electors vote again until the quota was filled.
translations.idiomatic: If winners fell short of quota, electors revoted among leading candidates until seats were filled.

sentences.zh: 其投票及格、額滿見遺者，作為候補當選人。

translations.literal: Those who met the vote threshold but were passed over when quotas were full served as alternate winners.
translations.idiomatic: Qualified candidates passed over when quotas were full became alternates.

sentences.zh: 諮議局辦事處造具當選人及候補當選人名冊，連同票紙，呈送互選監督，覆加選定，為資政院議員。

translations.literal: The consultative assembly office compiled registers of winners and alternates with ballot papers and submitted them to the mutual-election supervisor, who made a final selection as Imperial Consultative Assembly members.
translations.idiomatic: The assembly office compiled registers of winners and alternates with ballots and submitted them to the supervisor for final appointment as Imperial Consultative Assembly members.

sentences.zh: 不原應選者，得呈明互選監督辭退，依次將本屆當選人及候補當選人覆加選定補充。

translations.literal: Those unwilling to serve might petition the mutual-election supervisor to withdraw; winners and alternates of that term were then selected in order to fill the gap.
translations.idiomatic: Declining candidates could petition supervisors; that term's winners and alternates were then selected in order to fill gaps.

sentences.zh: 不敷選充者，舉行臨時互選。

translations.literal: When insufficient to fill seats, a temporary mutual election was held.
translations.idiomatic: If seats still could not be filled, a special mutual election was held.

sentences.zh: 選定後，由互選監督造具名冊，連同當選人及候補當選人原冊，咨送資政院。

translations.literal: After selection, the mutual-election supervisor compiled a register with the original registers of winners and alternates and forwarded them to the Imperial Consultative Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: After selection, supervisors compiled registers with the original winner and alternate lists and forwarded them to the assembly.

sentences.zh: 凡選充資政院議員者，不得兼充本省諮議局議員，有缺額時，由院行知該省督、撫，覆加選定補充，或舉行臨時互選。

translations.literal: Anyone appointed Imperial Consultative Assembly member could not simultaneously serve as a member of that province's consultative assembly; when there were vacancies, the assembly notified the provincial governor to make a final selection to fill them, or a temporary mutual election was held.
translations.idiomatic: Assembly members could not hold seats in their home province's consultative assembly; vacancies were filled by notification to governors for final selection or by special mutual election.

sentences.zh: 此資政院議員欽選、互選辦法之概要也。

translations.literal: This was the outline of methods for imperial selection and mutual election of Imperial Consultative Assembly members.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the outline of imperial selection and mutual election for assembly members.

sentences.zh: 各省諮議局議員選舉章程之規定，議員之選任，用複選舉法。

translations.literal: Under the regulations of provincial consultative assembly member election statutes, members were chosen by indirect election.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial consultative assembly election regulations prescribed indirect election for members.

sentences.zh: 複選之別於單選者，單選逕由選舉人投票選出議員，複選則先由選舉人選出若干選舉議員人，更令選舉議員人投票選出議員是也。

translations.literal: How indirect election differed from direct election: in direct election electors directly voted members into office; in indirect election electors first chose a number of elector-deputies, who then voted to choose members.
translations.idiomatic: Indirect election differed from direct election: direct voting chose members outright; indirect voting first chose elector-deputies, who then chose members.

sentences.zh: 諮議局議員定額，因各省戶口尚無確實統計，參酌各省取進學額及漕糧多寡以定準則。

translations.literal: Consultative assembly member quotas, because no reliable population statistics existed for each province, were set by reference to each province's quota for the provincial examination and the amount of grain tribute.
translations.idiomatic: With no reliable provincial population figures, member quotas were set by reference to provincial examination quotas and grain tribute.

sentences.zh: 奉天五十名，吉林三十名，黑龍江三十名，順直百四十名，江寧五十五名，江蘇六十六名，安徽八十三名，江西九十七名，浙江百十四名，福建七十二名，湖北八十名，湖南八十二名，山東百名，河南九十六名，山西八十六名，陝西六十三名，甘肅四十三名，新疆三十名，四川百零五名，廣東九十一名，廣西五十七名，雲南六十八名，貴州三十九名。

translations.literal: Fengtian fifty, Jilin thirty, Heilongjiang thirty, Zhili one hundred forty, Jiangning fifty-five, Jiangsu sixty-six, Anhui eighty-three, Jiangxi ninety-seven, Zhejiang one hundred fourteen, Fujian seventy-two, Hubei eighty, Hunan eighty-two, Shandong one hundred, Henan ninety-six, Shanxi eighty-six, Shaanxi sixty-three, Gansu forty-three, Xinjiang thirty, Sichuan one hundred five, Guangdong ninety-one, Guangxi fifty-seven, Yunnan sixty-eight, Guizhou thirty-nine.
