translations.idiomatic: Quotas were: Fengtian 50, Jilin 30, Heilongjiang 30, Zhili 140, Jiangning 55, Jiangsu 66, Anhui 83, Jiangxi 97, Zhejiang 114, Fujian 72, Hubei 80, Hunan 82, Shandong 100, Henan 96, Shanxi 86, Shaanxi 63, Gansu 43, Xinjiang 30, Sichuan 105, Guangdong 91, Guangxi 57, Yunnan 68, Guizhou 39.

sentences.zh: 京旗及各省駐防，以所住地方為本籍。

translations.literal: Metropolitan Banner personnel and garrison detachments in each province took their place of residence as native registration.
translations.idiomatic: Metropolitan Banner personnel and provincial garrisons registered residence where they lived as native place.

sentences.zh: 但旗制未改以前，京旗得於順直議員定額外，暫設專額十名；

translations.literal: But before the Banner system was reformed, Metropolitan Banner personnel might temporarily set aside ten dedicated seats beyond Zhili's member quota;
translations.idiomatic: Before Banner reform, Metropolitan Banner personnel received ten temporary dedicated seats beyond Zhili's quota;

sentences.zh: 各省駐防得於該省議員定額外，每省暫設專額一名至三名。

translations.literal: garrison detachments in each province might temporarily set aside one to three dedicated seats beyond that province's member quota.
translations.idiomatic: each provincial garrison received one to three temporary dedicated seats beyond its province's quota.

sentences.zh: 選舉權之規定，用限制選舉法。

translations.literal: Eligibility to vote was governed by restricted suffrage.
translations.idiomatic: Voting rights followed restricted suffrage.

sentences.zh: 凡屬本省籍貫之男子，年滿二十五歲以上，具下列資格之一者，有選舉諮議局議員之權：一，在本省地方辦理學務及公益事務滿三年以上著有成績者；

translations.literal: Any native-born man of the province aged twenty-five or above possessing one of the following qualifications had the right to elect consultative assembly members: first, those who had managed education or public welfare affairs in the province for three years or more with notable achievement;
translations.idiomatic: Native men aged twenty-five or older with any of these qualifications could vote for consultative assembly members: (1) three or more years' distinguished work in provincial education or public welfare;

sentences.zh: 二，在本國或外國中學堂及與中學同等或中學以上之學堂畢業者；

translations.literal: second, graduates of middle schools in China or abroad or schools of middle-school level or above;
translations.idiomatic: (2) graduation from a middle school or equivalent, at home or abroad;

sentences.zh: 三，有舉、貢、生員以上之出身者；

translations.literal: third, holders of the juren, gongsheng, or shengyuan degrees or higher;
translations.idiomatic: (3) juren, gongsheng, shengyuan, or higher degrees;

sentences.zh: 四，曾任實缺職官文七品、武五品以上未被參革者；

translations.literal: fourth, those who had held substantive offices as civil officials of the seventh rank or higher or military officials of the fifth rank or higher and had not been impeached and dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: (4) substantive civil rank 7+ or military rank 5+ without impeachment and dismissal;

sentences.zh: 五，在本省地方有五千元以上之營業資本或不動產者。

translations.literal: fifth, those with business capital or real property in the province worth five thousand yuan or more.
translations.idiomatic: (5) five thousand yuan or more in business capital or real property in the province.

sentences.zh: 凡非本籍之男子，年滿二十五歲，寄居本省滿十年以上，有萬元以上之營業資本或不動產者，亦得有選舉權。

translations.literal: Any non-native man aged twenty-five or above who had resided in the province ten years or more and possessed business capital or real property worth ten thousand yuan or more also had the right to vote.
translations.idiomatic: Non-natives aged twenty-five or older who had lived in the province ten years with ten thousand yuan or more in capital or property could also vote.

sentences.zh: 被選舉權之規定及其限制：凡屬本省籍貫或寄居本省滿十年以上之男子，年滿三十歲以上者，得被選舉為諮議局議員。

translations.literal: Regulations on eligibility to be elected and its restrictions: any native-born man or man who had resided in the province ten years or more, aged thirty or above, might be elected consultative assembly member.
translations.idiomatic: To stand for election: natives or ten-year residents aged thirty or older.

sentences.zh: 凡有下列情事之一者，不得有選舉權及被選舉權。

translations.literal: Anyone falling under one of the following circumstances had neither the right to vote nor the right to be elected.
translations.idiomatic: The following forfeit both voting and candidacy rights.

sentences.zh: 一，品行悖謬、營私武斷者；

translations.literal: first, those of depraved character who pursued private gain by arbitrary force;
translations.idiomatic: (1) depraved character or arbitrary pursuit of private gain;

sentences.zh: 二，曾處監禁以上之刑者；

translations.literal: second, those who had received imprisonment or heavier punishment;
translations.idiomatic: (2) prior imprisonment or heavier sentence;

sentences.zh: 三，營業不正者；

translations.literal: third, those engaged in improper business;
translations.idiomatic: (3) improper business;

sentences.zh: 四，失財產上信用被人控實未清結者；

translations.literal: fourth, those who had lost credit in property matters and been petitioned against with facts substantiated but not yet settled;
translations.idiomatic: (4) substantiated but unsettled charges of financial dishonesty;

sentences.zh: 五，吸食鴉片者；

translations.literal: fifth, opium smokers;
translations.idiomatic: (5) opium use;

sentences.zh: 六，有心疾者；

translations.literal: sixth, those with mental illness;
translations.idiomatic: (6) mental illness;

sentences.zh: 七，身家不清白者；

translations.literal: seventh, those of unclear personal or family background;
translations.idiomatic: (7) questionable personal or family background;

sentences.zh: 八，不識文義者。

translations.literal: eighth, those unable to read.
translations.idiomatic: (8) illiteracy.

sentences.zh: 其有所處地位不適於選舉議員及被選舉為議員者：一，本省官吏或幕友；

translations.literal: Those whose position was unsuitable for electing members or being elected member: first, provincial officials or staff;
translations.idiomatic: Those whose status barred them from voting or standing: (1) provincial officials or staff;

sentences.zh: 二，軍人；

translations.literal: second, military personnel;
translations.idiomatic: (2) military personnel;

sentences.zh: 三，巡警官、吏；

translations.literal: third, police officers and clerks;
translations.idiomatic: (3) police officers and clerks;

sentences.zh: 四，僧、道及宗教師；

translations.literal: fourth, Buddhist and Daoist clergy and religious teachers;
translations.idiomatic: (4) Buddhist, Daoist, and other clergy;

sentences.zh: 五，學堂肄業生：均停其選舉權及被選舉權。

translations.literal: fifth, students enrolled in schools: all had both voting and candidacy rights suspended.
translations.idiomatic: (5) enrolled students—all voting and candidacy rights suspended.

sentences.zh: 其現充小學教員者，停其被選舉權。

translations.literal: Those currently serving as primary-school teachers had candidacy rights suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Primary-school teachers could vote but not stand.

sentences.zh: 諮議局設議長一，副議長二，用單記投票法，分次互選。

translations.literal: The consultative assembly had one Speaker and two Deputy Speakers, chosen by single-ballot voting in successive mutual elections.
translations.idiomatic: One Speaker and two Deputy Speakers were chosen by single-ballot mutual election in stages.

sentences.zh: 設常駐議員，以議員額數十分之二為額，用連記投票法，一次互選。

translations.literal: Standing members were established at two-tenths of the member quota, chosen by cumulative-ballot voting in one mutual election.
translations.idiomatic: Standing members numbered one-fifth of the quota, chosen by cumulative ballot in one mutual election.

sentences.zh: 凡議員三年一改選，議長、副議長任期同。

translations.literal: All members were re-elected every three years; Speaker and Deputy Speakers served the same term.
translations.idiomatic: Members served three-year terms; Speaker and deputies served likewise.

sentences.zh: 常駐議員任期限一年。

translations.literal: Standing members served one-year terms.
translations.idiomatic: Standing members served one year.

sentences.zh: 議長因事出缺，以副議長遞補。

translations.literal: When the Speaker left office, Deputy Speakers filled in by succession.
translations.idiomatic: Speaker vacancies were filled by deputies in order.

sentences.zh: 副議長出缺，由議員互選充補。

translations.literal: When a Deputy Speaker left office, members mutual-elected a replacement.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy vacancies were filled by mutual election among members.

sentences.zh: 議員出缺，以複選候補當選人依次遞補。

translations.literal: When a member left office, indirect-election alternate winners filled in by order.
translations.idiomatic: Member vacancies were filled by indirect-election alternates in order.

sentences.zh: 議員改選，再被選者得連任，以一次為限。

translations.literal: At re-election, those elected again might serve consecutive terms, limited to once.
translations.idiomatic: Re-elected members could serve one consecutive term only.

sentences.zh: 議員非因下列事由，不得辭職：一，確有疾病，不能擔任職務者；

translations.literal: Members might not resign except for the following reasons: first, confirmed illness preventing performance of duties;
translations.idiomatic: Members could resign only for: (1) confirmed illness preventing service;

sentences.zh: 二，確有職業，不能常駐本省境內者；

translations.literal: second, confirmed occupation preventing permanent residence within the province;
translations.idiomatic: (2) occupation preventing permanent residence in the province;

sentences.zh: 三，其餘事由，經諮議局允許者。

translations.literal: third, other reasons permitted by the consultative assembly.
translations.idiomatic: (3) other reasons permitted by the assembly.

sentences.zh: 凡選舉區域，初選舉以庁、州、縣為選舉區，複選舉以府、直隸庁、州為選舉區。

translations.literal: For election districts, primary election took districts, subprefectures, and counties as election districts; indirect election took prefectures, directly administered departments, and subprefectures as election districts.
translations.idiomatic: Primary elections used districts, subprefectures, and counties; indirect elections used prefectures, directly administered departments, and subprefectures.

sentences.zh: 直隸庁、州及府之本管地方，均作為初選區。

translations.literal: Directly administered departments, subprefectures, and prefectures' own jurisdictions all counted as primary districts.
translations.idiomatic: Directly administered departments, subprefectures, and prefectural seats served as primary districts.

sentences.zh: 直隸庁無屬縣者，以附近之府為複選區。

translations.literal: Where a directly administered department had no subordinate counties, a nearby prefecture served as the indirect-election district.
translations.idiomatic: Departments without subordinate counties used a nearby prefecture as the indirect district.

sentences.zh: 初選區，庁以同知、通判，州、縣以知州、知縣為初選監督。

translations.literal: In primary districts, subprefectures used subprefect and intendant, districts and counties used district magistrate and county magistrate as primary supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: Primary supervisors were subprefects and intendants in subprefectures, district and county magistrates in districts and counties.

sentences.zh: 複選區，府以知府，直隸庁、州以同知、通判、知州為複選監督。

translations.literal: In indirect districts, prefectures used prefect, directly administered departments and subprefectures used subprefect, intendant, and subprefect magistrate as indirect supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: Indirect supervisors were prefects in prefectures, subprefects, intendants, and subprefect magistrates in departments and subprefectures.

sentences.zh: 府、直隸庁、州作為初選區者，得遴派教佐員為初選監督。

translations.literal: Where a prefecture, directly administered department, or subprefecture served as a primary district, educational assistants might be appointed primary supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: When prefectures, departments, or subprefectures doubled as primary districts, educational assistants could serve as primary supervisors.

sentences.zh: 初選、複選均設投票、開票、管理員、監察員若干名。

translations.literal: Both primary and indirect elections established several voting, ballot-opening, administrator, and inspector posts.
translations.idiomatic: Primary and indirect elections each appointed voting, counting, administrative, and inspection staff.

sentences.zh: 管理員不拘官紳，監察員以本地紳士為限。

translations.literal: Administrators were not limited to officials or gentry; inspectors were limited to local gentry.
translations.idiomatic: Administrators could be officials or gentry; inspectors had to be local gentry.

sentences.zh: 初選區選舉人名冊及當選人姓名票數，由初選監督申報複監督；

translations.literal: Primary-district elector registers and winners' names and vote counts were reported by primary supervisors to indirect supervisors;
translations.idiomatic: Primary supervisors reported elector registers and winner names and vote counts to indirect supervisors;

sentences.zh: 複選當選人姓名票數，由複選監督申報督、撫，分別咨報資政院、民政部立案。

translations.literal: indirect-election winners' names and vote counts were reported by indirect supervisors to governors, who separately memorialized the Imperial Consultative Assembly and the Ministry of Civil Affairs for filing.
translations.idiomatic: indirect supervisors reported winners to governors, who filed separately with the assembly and the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

sentences.zh: 選舉年限，三年一次，以正月十五日為初選日期，三月十五日為複選日期。

translations.literal: Elections occurred every three years, with the fifteenth day of the first month as the primary-election date and the fifteenth day of the third month as the indirect-election date.
translations.idiomatic: Elections were triennial: primary voting on the first month's fifteenth day, indirect voting on the third month's fifteenth day.

sentences.zh: 凡初選舉，初選監督按地方廣狹、人口多寡、分劃本管區域為若干投票區，分設選舉調查員，按照選舉資格，詳細調查，將合格選舉人造具名冊，於選舉期六個月以前，呈由複選監督申報督、撫，並宣示公眾。

translations.literal: For all primary elections, primary supervisors divided their jurisdictions into voting districts according to local extent and population, appointed election investigators, conducted detailed investigation according to voting qualifications, compiled registers of qualified electors, and six months before the election submitted them through indirect supervisors to governors and publicly announced them.
translations.idiomatic: Primary supervisors divided their jurisdictions into voting districts by size and population, appointed investigators, compiled qualified elector registers six months before election day, submitted them through indirect supervisors to governors, and published them.

sentences.zh: 如本人認為錯誤遺漏，得於宣示期內呈請初選監督更正。

translations.literal: If a person believed there were errors or omissions, he might petition the primary supervisor for correction during the public notice period.
translations.idiomatic: During the notice period, voters could petition primary supervisors to correct errors or omissions.

sentences.zh: 初選當選人額數，按照議員定額加多十倍。

translations.literal: The number of primary-election winners was set at ten times the member quota.
translations.idiomatic: Primary winners numbered ten times the member quota.

sentences.zh: 各初選區應出當選人若干名，由複選監督分配。

translations.literal: How many winners each primary district should produce was allocated by the indirect supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Indirect supervisors allocated winner quotas among primary districts.

sentences.zh: 投票用無名單記法，其有寫不依式者，夾寫他事者，字跡模糊者，不用頒發票紙者，選出之人不合被選資格者，作為廢票。

translations.literal: Voting used unsigned single-ballot method; ballots not conforming to form, carrying extraneous writing, with illegible handwriting, not using issued ballot paper, or choosing persons not meeting candidacy qualifications were void.
translations.idiomatic: Voting used unsigned single ballots; invalid ballots included nonstandard forms, extraneous writing, illegible hand, unstamped paper, or ineligible candidates.

sentences.zh: 以本區應出當選人額數除選舉人總數，所得半數，為當選票額。

translations.literal: Dividing the district's quota of winners by the total number of electors and taking half the quotient gave the winning vote threshold.
translations.idiomatic: The winning threshold was half the quotient of district quota divided by total electors.

sentences.zh: 得票不滿當選票額以上者，不得為初選當選人。

translations.literal: Those receiving fewer votes than the winning threshold could not be primary-election winners.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates below the threshold could not win primary election.

sentences.zh: 複選由初選當選人齊集複選監督所在地行之。

translations.literal: Indirect election was conducted where primary-election winners assembled at the indirect supervisor's location.
translations.idiomatic: Primary winners assembled at the indirect supervisor's seat for indirect election.

sentences.zh: 複選當選人，即為諮議局議員。

translations.literal: Indirect-election winners were consultative assembly members.
translations.idiomatic: Indirect-election winners became consultative assembly members.

sentences.zh: 各複選區應得議員若干名，由督、撫按全省議員定額分配，投票當選，一切與初選同。

translations.literal: How many members each indirect district should receive was allocated by the governor according to the province-wide member quota; voting and election procedures were the same as for primary election.
translations.idiomatic: Governors allocated member quotas among indirect districts province-wide; voting followed primary-election rules.

sentences.zh: 關於選舉之變更，如選舉人名冊有舞弊、作偽情事，或辦理不遵定章，被控判定確實者，初選、複選均無效。

translations.literal: Regarding election changes, if elector registers involved fraud or forgery, or handling failed to follow prescribed regulations, and petition and judgment confirmed the facts, both primary and indirect elections were void.
translations.idiomatic: If fraud, forgery, or procedural violations in elector registers were substantiated on petition, both primary and indirect elections were void.

sentences.zh: 當選議員有辭任、或疾病不能應選，或身故，或被選資格不符，當選票數不實，被控判定確實者，其當選無效，各以候補當選人遞補。

translations.literal: If an elected member resigned, was too ill to serve, died, lacked candidacy qualifications, or vote counts were false, and petition and judgment confirmed the facts, the election was void and alternate winners filled in by order.
translations.idiomatic: Substantiated petitions voided elections for resignation, illness, death, ineligibility, or false vote counts; alternates filled seats in order.

sentences.zh: 如選舉人確認辦理人員不遵定章，有舞弊、作偽證據，或當選人被選資格不符，當選票數不實，及落選人確信得票可當選而不與選，候補當選人名次錯誤、遺漏者，均得向該管衙門呈控。

translations.literal: If electors confirmed that handling personnel failed to follow prescribed regulations, with evidence of fraud or forgery, or that winners lacked candidacy qualifications or vote counts were false, or defeated candidates firmly believed their votes would have elected them but they were not chosen, or alternate winners' ranking was wrong or omitted, all might petition the competent yamen.
translations.idiomatic: Electors could petition competent authorities for procedural violations, fraud, ineligible winners, false counts, wrongly excluded winners, or errors in alternate ranking.

sentences.zh: 限自選舉日起三十日，凡選舉訴訟，初選向府、直隸庁、州衙門，複選向按察使衙門呈控。

translations.literal: Within thirty days from election day, all election lawsuits: primary petitions went to prefectural, directly administered department, and subprefectural yamens; indirect petitions went to the provincial surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Election petitions had to be filed within thirty days: primary cases to prefectural, department, or subprefectural offices; indirect cases to the provincial surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 各省已設審判庁者，分別向地方高等審判庁呈控。

translations.literal: In provinces where courts had been established, petitions went respectively to local high courts.
translations.idiomatic: Where courts existed, petitions went to local high courts instead.

sentences.zh: 不服判定者，初選得向按察使衙門，複選得向大理院上控。

translations.literal: Those dissatisfied with judgments: primary cases might appeal to the provincial surveillance commissioner; indirect cases might appeal to the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Appeals from primary judgments went to the surveillance commissioner; appeals from indirect judgments went to the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 限判定日起三個月。

translations.literal: The limit was three months from the date of judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Appeals had to be filed within three months of judgment.

sentences.zh: 已設審判庁者，照審判庁上控章程辦理。

translations.literal: Where courts had been established, appeals followed court appeal regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Where courts existed, appeals followed court procedures.

sentences.zh: 選舉人及辦理選舉人、選舉關係人，有違法行為，分別輕重，處以監禁、罰金有差；

translations.literal: Electors, election officials, and persons connected with elections who committed unlawful acts, according to severity, received imprisonment or fines in varying degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Electors, officials, and others involved in elections faced imprisonment or fines according to severity;

sentences.zh: 二年以上、十年以下，不得為選舉人及被選舉人。

translations.literal: for two to ten years they could not serve as electors or be elected.
translations.idiomatic: and lost voting and candidacy rights for two to ten years.

sentences.zh: 專額議員選舉人及被選舉人，以京旗及駐防人員為限，選舉及被選舉資格，與諮議局普通議員資格同。

translations.literal: Electors and candidates for dedicated-quota members were limited to Metropolitan Banner and garrison personnel; voting and candidacy qualifications were the same as for ordinary consultative assembly members.
translations.idiomatic: Dedicated-quota electors and candidates were limited to Metropolitan Banner and garrison personnel, with the same qualifications as ordinary members.

sentences.zh: 各省駐防專額議員之數，視該省駐防取進學額全數在十名以內者設議員一名，二十名以內設二名，二十名以外設三名。

translations.literal: The number of dedicated-quota members for garrisons in each province was set at one member where the garrison's total provincial examination quota was ten or fewer, two where twenty or fewer, and three beyond twenty.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison dedicated seats numbered one where the garrison's examination quota was ten or fewer, two where twenty or fewer, and three beyond twenty.

sentences.zh: 初選當選人額數，以議員定額十倍之數為準。

translations.literal: The number of primary-election winners was set at ten times the fixed quota of members.
translations.idiomatic: Primary-election winners numbered ten times the member quota.

sentences.zh: 複選當選人額數，以議員定額為準。

translations.literal: The number of indirect-election winners was set at the fixed quota of members.
translations.idiomatic: Indirect-election winners equaled the member quota.

sentences.zh: 調查選舉人名冊，由督、撫會同將軍、都統，於京旗及駐防人員內，各酌派選舉調查員。

translations.literal: Investigation of elector registers was conducted by governors, together with generals and commandants, who each dispatched election investigators among Metropolitan Banner and garrison personnel as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Governors, together with generals and commandants, appointed election investigators among Metropolitan Banner and garrison personnel to compile elector registers.

sentences.zh: 當選、改選、補選及訴訟、罰則各事，均照諮議局選舉章程辦理。

translations.literal: Election, re-election, supplementary election, litigation, and penalties were all handled according to the consultative assembly election regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Elections, re-elections, by-elections, appeals, and penalties all followed the consultative assembly election regulations.

sentences.zh: 此各省諮議局議員初選、複選辦法之概略也。

translations.literal: This was the outline of the methods for primary and indirect election of consultative assembly members in each province.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the outline of primary and indirect election for provincial consultative assembly members.

sentences.zh: 各省諮議局選舉，宣統元年各督、撫次第奏報舉行。

translations.literal: Elections for provincial consultative assemblies were reported in succession by each governor in the first year of Xuantong as having been conducted.
translations.idiomatic: In 1909 governors reported provincial consultative assembly elections held in turn.

sentences.zh: 於九月初一日，召集開會，舉行互選資政、諮議員。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month they were convoked to meet and held mutual election of assembly and consultative members.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month they convened and held mutual elections for assembly and consultative members.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，資政院奏請欽選各項議員，奉敕選定。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year the Imperial Consultative Assembly memorialized requesting imperial selection of members in each category; they were selected by imperial command.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 1910 the assembly memorialized for imperial appointment of members in each category; the throne appointed them by edict.

sentences.zh: 以八月二十日為召集期，九月初一日，資政院舉行第一次開院禮。

translations.literal: The twentieth day of the eighth month was set as the convocation date; on the first day of the ninth month the Imperial Consultative Assembly held its first opening ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Convocation was set for the twentieth day of the eighth month; on the first day of the ninth month the assembly held its inaugural opening ceremony.

sentences.zh: 監國攝政王代行蒞選，頒諭嘉勉議員。

translations.literal: The regent prince acting as regent attended in the sovereign's place, issued an instruction commending and encouraging the members.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince Regent attended on the sovereign's behalf and issued instructions commending the members.

sentences.zh: 三年九月，遵章第二次召集開會。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year, a second convocation and meeting were held according to regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of 1911 a second session was convened according to regulations.

sentences.zh: 資政院、諮議局議員選舉外，尚有地方自治團體之選舉。

translations.literal: Apart from elections for members of the Imperial Consultative Assembly and consultative assemblies, there were also elections for local self-government bodies.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond elections for the Imperial Consultative Assembly and provincial consultative assemblies, local self-government bodies also held elections.

sentences.zh: 地方自治為立憲基礎，列於籌備事宜清單。

translations.literal: Local self-government was the foundation of constitutional government and was listed on the schedule of preparatory matters.
translations.idiomatic: Local self-government formed the foundation of constitutional rule and appeared on the preparatory agenda.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十四年、宣統元年，憲政編查館先後核議，民政部奏城、鎮、鄉、府、庁、州、縣及京師地方自治暨選舉各章程，各省次第籌辦。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu and the first year of Xuantong, the Constitutional Compilation Bureau deliberated in succession; the Ministry of Civil Affairs memorialized regulations for local self-government and elections in cities, towns, townships, prefectures, subprefectures, departments, counties, and the capital, and each province prepared them in turn.
translations.idiomatic: In 1908 and 1909 the Constitutional Compilation Bureau reviewed successive drafts; the Ministry of Civil Affairs memorialized self-government and election regulations for cities, towns, villages, prefectures, departments, counties, and the capital, and provinces prepared them in turn.

sentences.zh: 其選舉辦法，與諮議局議員選舉略有出入。

translations.literal: Their election methods differed slightly from election of consultative assembly members.
translations.idiomatic: Their election procedures differed slightly from those for consultative assembly members.

sentences.zh: 以繁瑣，不備載。

translations.literal: Because they were cumbersome, they are not recorded in full here.
translations.idiomatic: Because of their complexity, they are not set forth here in detail.
